about:
Apparel Empire Sourcing & Textiles LLC operates from Edmond, Oklahoma. The company was established as a supply chain management firm focused on textile products, though its founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The firm provides sourcing services across a broad range of textile categories, including apparel, home textiles, hosiery, leather goods, sports equipment, fabrics, yarn, and accessories. It emphasizes the ability to process high-volume orders on rigid schedules while maintaining consistent quality, leveraging a network of suppliers in what it describes as the world's finest textile-producing countries.

Apparel Empire serves both international and domestic clients, tailoring its sourcing solutions to each customer's specific requirements. Its client base spans industries that require apparel, home furnishings, hosiery, leather products, sports gear, and raw textile materials such as cotton and knits.

The company highlights its flexible structure and strong customer focus as key differentiators, stating that its proximity to major textile manufacturing hubs enables competitive pricing and timely delivery. It also stresses rapid adaptation to changing customer demands and a commitment to quality assurance throughout the supply chain.
